## Purpose

The landing page after sign-in, with a card that shows whether cms-api answers its liveness probe.

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)). `useLiveHealth` checks once on load (checking, ok, error), and the card offers a manual re-check.

## Technologies

React, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

The index route `/`, page `StatusPage`.

## Where to change what

Card text and states: `StatusCard.tsx`; the check: `useLiveHealth.ts`; the call: `features/status`.
